# Pause audit

`customer_support.pb.sla_management.pause_audit` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **playbook**

> Sweep paused tickets on a cadence and read the last outbound message, not the status field. Anything without a live unanswered question goes back to running with the pause reversed.

The status field is the claim; the last outbound message is the evidence. Auditing the claim against itself is why invalid pauses survive in almost every support organisation — the abuse is trivially detectable and almost never looked for.
